changelog:
Ask about a meeting, and remove action items that don't apply to you.

Open a meeting and use "Ask about this meeting" to ask what was decided, who's doing what, or anything else from it. The answer comes from that meeting only; if something wasn't discussed, it says so.Your desktop answers when it's reachable; otherwise this phone answers with its on-device model.

Tap the X beside an action item to remove it. It's removed from your desktop too, and it won't come back when the meeting syncs again.
